# Chronic Disease EHR Dataset

[Link to Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/zara2099/chronic-disease-ehr-dataset?resource=download)

```{r}

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)

chronic_data <- read_csv("Chronic_Disease_EHR_Dataset.csv") 


```

```{r}
chronic_data %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  summarize(n_obs = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  summarize(
    n_clusters = n(),                     # number of unique participants
    avg_obs_per_cluster = mean(n_obs)
  ) %>%
  kable() # outputs into nice table :D
```

There are 1750 participants in this data set. With 4 observations on average per participant. 

# Exploratory Data Analysis

Our Primary outcome of interest is `Estimated_GFR`. or estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), a continuous measure of kidney function.


```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplot-GFR-Sex-Diabetes
#| fig-cap: "Box-Plot of Estimated GFR by Sex and Diabetes Status"

ggplot(chronic_data, aes(x = Sex, y = Estimated_GFR, fill = Diabetes_Status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") 

```

 
```{r}
#| label: fig-scatterplot-GFR-Age-Sex-Diabetes
#| fig-cap: "Scatter Plot of Estimated GFR by Age, grouped by Sex and Diabetes Status"

ggplot(chronic_data, aes(x = Age, y = Estimated_GFR, color = Diabetes_Status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Sex) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") 

```

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatterplot-GFR-BMI-Sex-Diabetes
#| fig-cap: "Scatter Plot of Estimated GFR by BMI, grouped by Sex and Diabetes Status"

ggplot(chronic_data, aes(x = Body_Mass_Index, y = Estimated_GFR, color = Diabetes_Status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap( ~ Sex) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") 


```

```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplot-GFR-Visit-Diabetes
#| fig-cap: "BoxPlot of Estimated GFR over time (Visit Number), by Diabetes Status"

ggplot(chronic_data, (aes(x = as.factor(Visit_Number), y = Estimated_GFR, fill = Diabetes_Status))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "top") 
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-spaghettiplot-GFR-Vist
#| fig-cap: "Spaghetti Plot of Estimated GFR by Visit Number, grouped by Diabetes Status"

# Taking a sample of the data so that it doesn't look so cluttered in the plot
set.seed(123)

n_subjects <- 200

sampled_ids <- chronic_data %>%
  distinct(Patient_ID) %>%
  slice_sample(n = n_subjects)

sample_data <- chronic_data %>%
  semi_join(sampled_ids, by = "Patient_ID")


# Spaghetti Plot
ggplot(sample_data, aes(x= Visit_Number, y = Estimated_GFR, group = Patient_ID )) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Diabetes_Status) 
```
